descriptionChirho: Proper name Yoshiyahu (יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ), the righteous king of Judah who instituted major religious reforms (2 Kings 22-23); both bare nominative and prepositional (le-) forms refer to the same individual. Cross-linguistically uniform: Spanish Josías, Hindi योशिय्याहू, Arabic يُوشِيَّاهُو, Korean 요시야, Swahili Yosia — all rendering the same personal name across grammatical contexts.
